confirming_evidence: Price closed at 7,757.64, the highest close of the sequence, in the top third of the daily range — the intraday chart (01) shows a sustained 3:00-4:00pm drive from ~7,733 to 7,762 with RSI recovering from ~28 to ~60, a strong close reversing three consecutive bottom-third finishes.

Trend skeleton is unambiguously bullish across all timeframes: the 50-day (7,494.24) is well above a rising 200-day (7,050.03), and the 6-month/1-year charts (05, 06) show an uninterrupted higher-highs sequence off the March low with the 20-day above the 50-day above the 200-day.

Credit is the single cleanest confirmation: junk vs investment-grade spread has tightened to 1.23 (chart 15), the tightest of the entire year and at the bottom of its multi-year range with a score of 97 — risk appetite is confirming, not diverging.

Volatility is benign and falling: VIX 14.90 (chart 13), below its ~17.3 50-day MA and back under the 15 complacency line, with realized 20-day vol at 14.37% — no stress signature in the options complex.

Money flow turned up from the buy-watch zone: the 5-day chart (02) shows MFI lifting from ~22-25 to ~43 and RSI stabilizing near 65, easing the extreme Aug 6 divergence while the 1-month/3-month charts (03, 04) hold MFI near 70 in the healthy band.

Monte Carlo produced its strongest reading of the arc: adjusted prob_up_first 65.95% with a 2-day median to the 7,793.68 upside target versus 9 days to 7,610.41, and an 87% conditional cascade to 7,891 if the record breaks.

Bollinger structure remains constructive: on the 1-month and 3-month charts price is walking the upper band with the band itself expanding, and the 20-day SMA (~7,530 area on the 1-month view) is rising beneath price — no close below the 20-day and therefore no regime-shift signal.

Sentiment complex firmed without reaching extremes: Fear & Greed rose to 64 (chart 08), the 125-day momentum gauge scores 80 with price far above the 7,170 MA (chart 09), and safe-haven demand at 2.94 (chart 14) shows stocks outperforming bonds — risk-on but not yet the >75 extreme-greed trim trigger.

Price making all-time highs on this level of participation is textbook narrow leadership and a topping warning.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: When breadth and credit both diverge from price, elevate caution even if price has not yet broken down; headline strength with weak breadth indicates narrow leadership.

primary_tension: A record-setting, credit-confirmed, top-third-close breakout with the best Monte Carlo up-skew of the entire arc (65.95% adjusted up-first, 2-day median to 7,793.68) is colliding with an unmistakably late-cycle internal profile: extension has crossed into the elevated band at +10.04% above the 200-day, ERP is compressed to 0.24% in the valuation-ceiling zone with the re-entry floor 5.1% below spot, McClellan breadth (959) and net new 52-week highs (1.14) remain at cycle-low participation as price makes all-time highs, 5-day MFI is still far below its Aug 4 peak at a higher price, VIX at 14.90 signals complacency rather than fear, and the probability edge fails the 70% Late Bull threshold for a twelfth consecutive session — meaning the strongest bullish evidence set of the arc is still not actionable under the governing regime.
